evidence: Inspected the complete current draft definition. It fixes a proper Borel prior, prior-predictive joint law, data-indexed posterior-kernel version, fixed-truth sampling law, and expected posterior-tail definition of an ell2 contraction rate. The open problem defines its no-log diameter target explicitly and asks for its compatibility with posterior credibility and exact coverage; this edge supplies the rate convention, not a proof that the requested diameter rate is attained. The supplier is draft; this interface inspection is not independent approval.
